title: Client Services Administrator
description: Client Services Administrator 26,230 per annum Hybrid (Stone) A well-established organisation is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Client Services Administrator to join its busy and supportive team. This role is ideal for an experienced administrator who enjoys building strong client relationships, delivering excellent customer service, and managing a varied workload in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will play a key part in ensuring client requests are handled efficiently, professionally, and accurately. Key Responsibilities - Action client instructions in a timely and professional manner. - Manage customer payments received at the office. - Process incoming correspondence, including emails and written communications. - Maintain accurate records and perform data entry tasks. - Produce and distribute remittance information to clients. - Complete banking procedures, including payment posting and associated administration. - Conduct investigations to obtain updated contact information where required. - Provide administrative support to operational teams. - Respond to client enquiries via telephone, email, and social media channels. - Deliver a high standard of service while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. About the Candidate The successful applicant will demonstrate: - Previous experience in an administrative role. - Strong IT skills and confidence using business social media platforms. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - A high level of accuracy and attention to detail. - The ability to prioritise workloads and manage changing deadlines. - A resilient and adaptable approach to work. - Strong organisational and time management skills. - A professional, personable, and customer-focused attitude. - The ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. What's on Offer? - Salary of 26,230 per annum. - Hybrid working arrangement. - Structured training and development programme. - 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. - Company sick pay scheme. - Mental health support, including access to private counselling. - Christmas shutdown period. - Regular team-building and social events. - Casual dress Fridays. - A friendly and supportive working environment. - Genuine opportunities for career progression and professional development. Apply Now This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and motivated administrator to join a growing organisation that values teamwork, development, and exceptional client service. Candidates who are passionate about delivering a high standard of support and building positive client relationships are encouraged to apply.

title: Customer Service Administrator
company: Chase Taylor Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description: Are you an organised and customer-focused administrator with a passion for delivering outstanding service? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy building strong relationships with customers? We're looking for a Customer Service Administrator to become a key member of a busy customer service team, supporting customers from order through to delivery. If you're a great communicator with excellent attention to detail and enjoy solving problems, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll be doing: - Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently. - Handling customer enquiries via phone and email with professionalism. - Providing stock availability updates and delivery ETAs. - Liaising with Sales, Warehouse and Logistics teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment. - Supporting the external sales team with day-to-day administration. - Maintaining accurate customer records and company systems. - Delivering exceptional customer service at every stage of the customer journey. What we're looking for: - Previous experience in a customer service or administration role. - Excellent communication and telephone skills. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload. - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel. - A proactive, positive attitude and excellent attention to detail. - Experience with order processing or within manufacturing, distribution or building products would be advantageous but isn't essential. What's on offer: - Monday to Friday working hours with an early finish on Fridays. - The opportunity to join a well-established, growing business. - Friendly and supportive team environment. - A varied role where your contribution genuinely makes a difference. If you're passionate about customer service and looking for your next opportunity, apply today!
